a.lede: The city of Starbase, Texas, is set to vote on a proposed $24 billion data center to be built within its limits, but the SpaceX company town may not provide the friendly regulatory environment that owner Elon Musk might have hoped for.
a.title: Elon Musk wants to build a s $24 billion gas-powered AI supercomputer in Texas company town

b.lede: Envision has delivered the first 120MW of its Galaxy AI datacenter in less than a year, combining wind farms, battery storage and an unconventional cooling system to cut costs and keep power-hungry servers running
b.title: China builds massive 800-megawatt AI data center campus to rival US Stargate project
